name: Peanut Chicken Rice Noodle Bowl with Snap Peas, Carrots & Cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve snap peas crosswise. Add to the bowl with the green onions and set aside.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and almost cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Add green onions and snap peas to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons.

When the chicken and veggies are done, add peanut sauce, water, and soy sauce to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is warmed through and thickened slightly, 3-4 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup peanut sauce
⅓ cup water
3 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Add drained noodles to the pot, toss to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide saucy noodles, chicken, and veggies between bowls; top with cucumber and carrots. Enjoy!
